column1: # The 500-file mix (spec, Fixtures: 220 photos, 120 documents, 100 PDFs, 40 audio files of about 1 minute and 20 video files of about 30
# seconds, no code), written by hand. Read by `kit-fixtures.sh build mix500` (fixtures/mix500). Tab separated, one fact a line:
#   scene     <sky top> <sky bottom> <ground> <objects>     one of the pictures the 20 videos are made of (objects as in golden-photos.tsv)
#   sentence  <text>                                         one spoken line of the 40 audio files (no comma; four of them, 15 s apart, make a file)
#   words     <words, space separated>                       the vocabulary of the documents and the PDF pages (about 1,000 characters each)
# Nothing here is a golden fixture: no query of the key asks for any of it.
